title: CMDDR Document
description: One concrete magisterial document / speech. References a Genre. May be fully described by its Genre alone (no Assessments) or carry one Assessment per notable passage.

id.description: Canonical identifier: 'mag:{issuer}/{incipit-slug}-{year}'. The issuer segment is the local part of issuerId. The exact form is fixed by idStatus below. See the design spec §3.

genre.description: Foreign key -> genre.id in data/genres.json. Null when the source genre has no Genre Registry row yet; sourceGenreLabel then records the raw label.

issuerId.description: Prefixed registry id of the concrete issuer, e.g. 'rp:john-paul-ii', 'oec:vatican-ii'.

issuerType.description: Role/capacity of the issuer. Drives the computed-infallibility rule; must be one of the genre's issuerTypes.

promulgatedBy.description: Optional prefixed id of the pope who promulgated the document, when distinct from the issuer. Does not change issuerType.

incipit.description: The incipit as printed by the source, unnormalised (e.g. 'Adiutricem populi').

incipitLang.description: ISO 639-1 language of the incipit; vernacular incipits are first-class.

idStatus.description: 'minted' ids are permanent; 'provisional' ids may be re-minted.

sigla.description: Conventional scholarly abbreviation (EV, LG, GS). Display only, never a key.

sourceGenreLabel.description: Genre label exactly as the source prints it (e.g. 'Enciclica', 'Protesta').

alsoShelvedAs.description: Other vatican.va shelves the same document is filed under; the shelves are not disjoint.

scope.description: Overrides genre.defaultScope when the addressee differs.

characteristics.description: Non-exclusive metadata a papal bull may bear. 'dogmatic-definition' asserts the document contains an ex cathedra definition and must be backed by a Table 2 assessment with register=extraordinary and intent=definitive.

descriptiveTitle.description: Optional descriptive title of a conciliar Constitution (mutually exclusive; omit for a plain constitution such as Sacrosanctum Concilium). Descriptive of purpose only — NOT a claim of authority, and unlike 'dogmatic-definition' it is not backed by any assessment.

aliases.description: Alternative titles (e.g. 'The Gospel of Life'). Incipits live in the incipit field.

allOf.description: a minted id requires an incipit; a null genre requires the raw source label
a minted id is issuer/incipit-slug-year, optionally extended to the full date to resolve a collision
a provisional id is issuer/genre-slug-YYYY-MM-DD with an optional ordinal
